field_notes.structure: Each lw_mastery row is ONE level of a mastery node. Same group = same node, different Lv. mastery_id is unique per row/level.
field_notes.mastery_group: '99999'=standalone nodes (5 permanent starter nodes, no color/logo), '10000'=standard engineer-tree nodes, '10001'=seasonal linked nodes
field_notes.type: 1=passive stat node (single extraPara stat effect), 2=active/special node (links to hero skill via link_skill)
field_notes.need_mastery: Mastery row ID that must be max-leveled first. Small values (e.g., 3) mean "need profession tier N" not a mastery id.
field_notes.prerequisite_groups: Group IDs (same as group field) that must be completed before this node. Prereqs are group-level not individual-level.
field_notes.link_skill: Hero skill ID enhanced or unlocked by this mastery. Overlaps partially with lw_hero_skill. Most are mastery-internal skill IDs.
field_notes.be_enhance_group: Group ID of the mastery node that this node enhances/buffs. '99999'=this node is a primary node, not an enhancer.
field_notes.extra_condition: Format 1: 1,building_id,level = requires building at level. Format 2: 2,day = available from season day N.
field_notes.desc_condition: Season_step value at which description_new becomes active in UI. description_new is a UI resource index (engine-internal), excluded.
field_notes.power_note: lw_mastery has no explicit power column. Most mastery stats are economic (power_cala_type=0) and do not contribute to Hero Power. power_computed reflects combat stat contribution where applicable.
field_notes.lw_mastery_exp: Profession Hall level XP thresholds (180 levels). Cross-reference: player profession level gates need_home_lv.
field_notes.masteryExp: Hero mastery level XP thresholds (180 levels). Used for the hero-level mastery unlock system.
field_notes.mastery_lock: Always None in current data — deprecated/unused field.
field_notes.over_view: Always 1 (display flag) — excluded from analytics output.
field_notes.value1: 1=skill learnable; None only for the 5 starter mastery_group=99999 nodes.
field_notes.des_value: Numeric value displayed in description template, e.g., "Gathering Speed +{des_value}%". Increases with level.
field_notes.recommend_weight: AI priority weight for auto-recommendation. 0=not recommended; higher=recommended sooner. Values: 0–30000.
field_notes.icon: Icon resource ID (engine asset reference, not a URL).
field_notes.pos: UI layout position (1-4) within the mastery tree grid.
field_notes.season_step: Season progression step when this node unlocks in the seasonal mastery tree.
